title: Quietly Comforting French Bun Wrap
description: A malty and snappy French dish featuring buns grilled to perfection on a robata grill, wrapped in a pandan leaf for a comforting and satvik-friendly meal. This dish is perfect for a cozy evening snack.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the French buns in half and brush the cut side with olive oil.
Grill the buns on the robata grill for 2-3 minutes or until lightly toasted.
In a small bowl, mix together the malted barley flour, salt, and black pepper.
Sprinkle the malted barley flour mixture evenly over the grilled buns.
Top each bun with grilled zucchini, roasted red bell peppers, and a sprinkle of malted barley flour.
Wrap each bun in a pandan leaf, making sure to seal the edges securely.
Serve the Quietly Comforting French Bun Wrap immediately and enjoy.
To add extra flavor, serve with a side of your favorite satvik-friendly sauce or chutney.
